From c65bd945d1c08c3db756821b6bf9f1c4a77b29c6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hyunwoo Kim <imv4bel@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 05:22:39 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] Bluetooth: L2CAP: Validate PDU length before reading SDU
 length in l2cap_ecred_data_rcv()

l2cap_ecred_data_rcv() reads the SDU length field from skb->data using
get_unaligned_le16() without first verifying that skb contains at least
L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE (2) bytes. When skb->len is less than 2, this reads
past the valid data in the skb.

The ERTM reassembly path correctly calls pskb_may_pull() before reading
the SDU length (l2cap_reassemble_sdu, L2CAP_SAR_START case). Apply the
same validation to the Enhanced Credit Based Flow Control data path.

Fixes: aac23bf63659 ("Bluetooth: Implement LE L2CAP reassembly")
Signed-off-by: Hyunwoo Kim <imv4bel@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Luiz Augusto von Dentz <luiz.von.dentz@intel.com>

diff --git a/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c b/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c
index 0882b5ac2ecc..30fd6848938e 100644
--- a/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c
+++ b/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c
@@ -6690,6 +6690,11 @@ static int l2cap_ecred_data_rcv(struct l2cap_chan *chan, struct sk_buff *skb)
 	if (!chan->sdu) {
 		u16 sdu_len;
 
+		if (!pskb_may_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE)) {
+			err = -EINVAL;
+			goto failed;
+		}
+
 		sdu_len = get_unaligned_le16(skb->data);
 		skb_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE);
 
-- 
2.34.1

## Patch Summary

### Modifications in Each File
- **File: `net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c`**
  - In the function `l2cap_ecred_data_rcv()`, a new `pskb_may_pull()` check was added before reading the SDU length field from the skb.
  - The line `if (!pskb_may_pull(skb, L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE))` is inserted right before `sdu_len = get_unaligned_le16(skb->data)`. If the skb does not contain at least `L2CAP_SDULEN_SIZE` (2) bytes, the function sets `err = -EINVAL` and jumps to the `failed` label.
  - No other lines or files are changed.

### Relationships Between the Modifications
- The change is localized to a single function within a single file. It addresses a potential out‑of‑bounds read when processing an Enhanced Credit Based Flow Control data packet.
- The fix aligns the validation logic with the existing practice in the ERTM reassembly path (`l2cap_reassemble_sdu`, L2CAP_SAR_START case), which already uses `pskb_may_pull()` before reading the SDU length. This ensures that the skb is large enough before accessing its data, preventing a read past the valid data boundary.
